Response.ArrivalInstr: On arrival once you've collected your luggage and exited the baggage hall please go to level minus 2 (-2) and see our team at the Beniconnect desk who will be waiting to direct you to your transfer vehicle. Bear in mind shuttle transfers sometimes operate on a schedule or need to wait for other customers so there may be a wait of up to one hour before departing. If you have any difficulty in locating your transfer please call our local partner on +34 965 059 089
Response.DepInstr: When you're going home please ensure you are ready to go with all of your party and their luggage 15 minutes before the advertised time. Two days before you fly home, your departure information including pick-up time will be available at easyjet.w2mdmc.com/en-en (you'll need your 7 digit holiday booking reference) - we'll also send you an SMS with the details. If you have any queries, our local partner is available on +34 965 059 089
